title.en: Volume 31 Treatises 12: Rites 4 - Memorial Presentation Rituals, Emperors' Appreciation, Empressess Appreciation, Crown Princes' Appreciation, Award Ceremonies, Recognition of Worthy Officials, Treasures, Miscellaneous Ceremonies
title.raw: 卷三十一 志第十二: 禮四 奏告儀 皇帝恭謝儀 皇后恭謝儀 皇太子恭謝儀 薦新 功臣配享 寶玉 雜儀 Volume 31 Treatises 12: Rites 4 - Memorial Presentation Rituals, Emperors' Appreciation, Empressess Appreciation, Crown Princes' Appreciation, Award Ceremonies, Recognition of Worthy Officials, Treasures, Miscellaneous Ceremonies

sentences.zh: 奏告儀

translations.literal: Rite of Memorial Presentation
translations.idiomatic: The Rite of Memorial Announcement

sentences.zh: 皇帝即位、加元服、受尊號、納後、冊命、巡狩、征伐、封祀、請諡、營修廟寢，凡國有大事皆告。

translations.literal: When the emperor succeeded to the throne, received the coming-of-age cap, received an honorific title, took an empress, issued appointments, conducted imperial tours, undertook military campaigns, performed the feng and shan sacrifices, requested posthumous titles, or undertook construction or repair of temple dormitories—in all such great affairs of state, memorial announcements were presented.
translations.idiomatic: Whenever the emperor acceded, came of age, received an honorific title, installed an empress, issued appointments, toured the realm, went to war, performed the feng and shan rites, sought a posthumous title, or built or repaired ancestral temple quarters, every major affair of state required a memorial announcement.

sentences.zh: 或一室，或遍告及原廟，並一獻禮，用祝幣。

translations.literal: Sometimes to a single shrine chamber, sometimes announcing throughout and to the original temples; in all cases a single-offering rite was used, with prayer silks.
translations.idiomatic: Announcements might be made to a single chamber or broadcast through all shrines, including the original ancestral temples; each used a one-offering rite with prayer silks.

sentences.zh: 皇統以後，凡皇帝受尊號、冊皇后太子、禘祫、升祔、奉安、奉遷等事皆告，郊祀則告配帝之室。

translations.literal: After the Huangtong reign, whenever the emperor received an honorific title, installed the empress or crown prince, performed the di and xia sacrifices, ascended tablets in joint worship, enshrined spirit tablets, or transferred spirit tablets, and for other such matters, announcements were made; for suburban sacrifices the announcement was made at the chamber of the associated deity.
translations.idiomatic: From the Huangtong period onward, receiving an honorific title, installing the empress or crown prince, di and xia sacrifices, ascending tablets to joint worship, enshrinement, and spirit-tablet transfers all required announcement; suburban sacrifices required announcement at the associated deity's chamber.

sentences.zh: 大定十四年三月十七日，詔更禦名，命左丞相良弼告天地，平章守道告太廟，左丞石琚告昭德皇后廟，禮部尚書張景仁告社稷，及遣官祭告五嶽。

translations.literal: On the seventeenth day of the third month of the fourteenth year of Dading, an edict changed the imperial personal name; the Left Chancellor Liangbi was ordered to announce to Heaven and Earth, the Chief Councillor Shoudao to the Grand Ancestral Temple, the Left Vice Councillor Shi Ju to the temple of Empress Zhaode, the Minister of Rites Zhang Jingren to the altars of soil and grain, and officials were dispatched to announce sacrifices to the Five Sacred Peaks.
translations.idiomatic: On the 17th day of the third month of Dading 14, an edict changed the emperor's personal name. Left Chancellor Liangbi was sent to announce to Heaven and Earth, Chief Councillor Shoudao to the Grand Ancestral Temple, Left Vice Councillor Shi Ju to Empress Zhaode's temple, Minister of Rites Zhang Jingren to the altars of soil and grain, and officials were dispatched to announce sacrifices at the Five Sacred Peaks.

sentences.zh: 前期二日，太廟令掃除廟內外，設告官以下次所。

translations.literal: Two days before, the director of the Grand Ancestral Temple swept clean inside and outside the temple and set out the resting places for the announcing officials and those below them.
translations.idiomatic: Two days beforehand, the director of the Grand Ancestral Temple swept the temple inside and out and arranged resting stations for the announcing officials and their attendants.

sentences.zh: 前一日，行事官赴祀所清齋。

translations.literal: On the previous day, the officiating officials went to the place of sacrifice and observed ritual purification.
translations.idiomatic: On the eve of the rite, the officiating officials went to the sacrificial site to observe ritual purification.

sentences.zh: 告日前三刻，禮直官引太廟令帥其屬，入殿開室戶，掃除鋪筵，設幾於北墉下，如時享儀。

translations.literal: At the third quarter before the announcement day, the ritual protocol officer led the director of the Grand Ancestral Temple and his subordinates into the hall, opened the shrine doors, swept and spread mats, and set tables below the north wall, as in the seasonal offering rite.
translations.idiomatic: Three quarters of an hour before the announcement, the ritual protocol officer led the temple director and his staff into the hall, opened the shrine doors, swept and laid mats, and set tables below the north wall, following the seasonal offering procedure.

sentences.zh: 禮直官帥祀祭官陳幣篚於室戶之左，陳祝版於室戶之右案上。

translations.literal: The ritual protocol officer led the sacrificial officers in placing baskets of silks to the left of the shrine door and placing the prayer tablets on the table to the right of the shrine door.
translations.idiomatic: The ritual protocol officer led the sacrificial officers to set baskets of silks to the left of the shrine door and prayer tablets on the table to the right.

sentences.zh: 及設香案祭器，皆藉以席，每位各左一籩實以鹿脯，右一豆實以鹿臡。

translations.literal: When setting out incense tables and sacrificial vessels, all were placed on mats; for each spirit seat, one basket on the left filled with dried venison and one vessel on the right filled with minced venison.
translations.idiomatic: Incense tables and sacrificial vessels were set out on mats; at each seat a basket of dried venison was placed on the left and a vessel of minced venison on the right.

sentences.zh: 犧尊一，置於坫，加勺、冪，在殿上室戶之左，北向，實以酒，每位一瓶。

translations.literal: One sacrificial wine vessel was placed on the altar platform with ladle and cover, to the left of the shrine door in the hall, facing north, filled with wine, one bottle for each seat.
translations.idiomatic: A sacrificial wine vessel with ladle and cover was set on the altar platform to the left of the shrine door, facing north, filled with wine—one bottle per seat.

sentences.zh: 設燭於神位前。

translations.literal: Candles were set before the spirit seats.
translations.idiomatic: Candles were placed before each spirit seat.

sentences.zh: 又設盥爵洗位橫街之南稍東。

translations.literal: A hand-washing and goblet-washing station was also set slightly east of the south side of the cross street.
translations.idiomatic: A hand-washing and goblet-washing station was also set just east of the south side of the cross street.

sentences.zh: 設告官褥位，于殿下東階之南，西向，餘官在其後稍南。

translations.literal: The announcing official's mat seat was set south of the east steps below the hall, facing west; the remaining officials stood slightly south behind him.
translations.idiomatic: The announcing official's mat was placed south of the east steps below the hall, facing west, with the other officials standing slightly to the south behind him.

sentences.zh: 又設望燎位於西神門外之北。

translations.literal: A station for viewing the burning offering was also set north of the west spirit gate.
translations.idiomatic: A station for viewing the burning offering was also set north of the west spirit gate, outside the temple.

sentences.zh: 告日未明，禮直官引太廟令、太祝、宮闈令入，當階間北面西上立定。

translations.literal: Before dawn on the announcement day, the ritual protocol officer led the director of the Grand Ancestral Temple, the chief invoker, and the palace gate director in; they took their places between the steps, facing north and ascending from the west.
translations.idiomatic: Before dawn on announcement day, the ritual protocol officer led in the temple director, chief invoker, and palace gate director, who took their stations between the steps, facing north from the west side.

sentences.zh: 奉禮贊：「再拜。

translations.literal: The ritual attendant intoned: "Bow twice."
translations.idiomatic: The ritual attendant called out: "Bow twice."

sentences.zh: 」訖，升自西階，太祝、宮闈令各入室，出神主設於座，如常儀。

translations.literal: When finished, they ascended by the west steps; the chief invoker and palace gate director each entered a shrine chamber, brought out the spirit tablets, and set them on their seats, as in the usual rite.
translations.idiomatic: When this was done, they ascended the west steps; the chief invoker and palace gate director each entered a shrine, brought out the spirit tablets, and set them on their seats according to usual procedure.

sentences.zh: 次引告官入，就位。

translations.literal: Next the announcing official was led in and took his place.
translations.idiomatic: Next the announcing official was led in and took his station.

sentences.zh: 禮直官稍前，贊：「有司謹具，請行事。

translations.literal: The ritual protocol officer stepped slightly forward and intoned: "The officials have duly prepared; please proceed with the rite."
translations.idiomatic: The ritual protocol officer stepped forward and announced: "The officials have made all preparations; please proceed with the rite."

sentences.zh: 」又贊：「再拜。

translations.literal: He then intoned again: "Bow twice."
translations.idiomatic: He then called out again: "Bow twice."

sentences.zh: 」在位者拜，訖，禮直官引告官就盥洗位，盥手，訖，詣神位前，搢笏，跪，三上香。

translations.literal: Those in position bowed; when finished, the ritual protocol officer led the announcing official to the hand-washing station to wash his hands; when finished, he went before the spirit seat, inserted his tablet, knelt, and offered incense three times.
translations.idiomatic: Those in position bowed. The ritual protocol officer then led the announcing official to wash his hands, after which he went before the spirit seat, inserted his tablet, knelt, and offered incense three times.

sentences.zh: 執事者以幣授奉禮郎，西向授告官。

translations.literal: The attendants handed the silks to the ritual attendant, who presented them facing west to the announcing official.
translations.idiomatic: Attendants handed the silks to the ritual attendant, who presented them to the announcing official from the west.

sentences.zh: 告官受幣，奠訖，執笏，俯伏，興，退就戶外位，再拜。

translations.literal: The announcing official received the silks and placed them as offerings; when finished, he took his tablet, prostrated himself, rose, withdrew to the position outside the door, and bowed twice.
translations.idiomatic: The announcing official received the silks and placed them as offerings, then took his tablet, prostrated himself, rose, withdrew to the position outside the door, and bowed twice.

sentences.zh: 詣次位行禮如上儀，訖，降復位。

translations.literal: He went to the next seat and performed the rite as above; when finished, he descended and returned to his place.
translations.idiomatic: He proceeded to the next seat and performed the same rite; when finished, he descended and returned to his station.

sentences.zh: 少頃，引告官再詣爵洗位，讀祝、舉祝官後從。

translations.literal: After a short while, the announcing official was led again to the goblet-washing station, with the prayer-reader and prayer-lifter following behind.
translations.idiomatic: Shortly afterward, the announcing official was led again to the goblet-washing station, followed by the officials who would read and lift the prayer.

sentences.zh: 至位，北向立，搢笏，洗拭爵，訖，授執事者。

translations.literal: Arriving at the station, he stood facing north, inserted his tablet, washed and wiped the goblet; when finished, he handed it to the attendants.
translations.idiomatic: At the station he stood facing north, inserted his tablet, washed and wiped the goblet, then handed it to the attendants.

sentences.zh: 執笏升，詣酒尊所，西向立，執爵，執尊者舉冪酌酒，告官以授執事者。

translations.literal: Holding his tablet, he ascended and went to the wine vessel, stood facing west, took the goblet; the vessel attendant lifted the cover and poured wine, and the announcing official handed it to the attendants.
translations.idiomatic: Tablet in hand, he ascended to the wine vessel, stood facing west, and took the goblet; the vessel attendant lifted the cover and poured wine, which the announcing official then handed to the attendants.

sentences.zh: 詣神位前，北向，搢笏，跪，執爵三祭酒，執笏，俯伏，興，退就戶外位，北向立俟，讀祝文，訖，再拜。

translations.literal: He went before the spirit seat, faced north, inserted his tablet, knelt, and with the goblet performed the three libations; he took his tablet, prostrated himself, rose, withdrew to the position outside the door, stood facing north and waited while the prayer was read; when finished, he bowed twice.
translations.idiomatic: He went before the spirit seat, faced north, inserted his tablet, knelt, and poured three libations; then he took his tablet, prostrated himself, rose, and withdrew outside the door to stand facing north while the prayer was read. When the reading was finished, he bowed twice.

sentences.zh: 詣次位行禮如上儀。

translations.literal: He went to the next seat and performed the rite as above.
translations.idiomatic: He proceeded to the next seat and performed the same rite.

sentences.zh: 訖，與讀祝官皆復位。

translations.literal: When finished, he and the prayer-reader both returned to their places.
translations.idiomatic: When this was done, he and the prayer-reader both returned to their stations.

sentences.zh: 禮直官贊曰：「再拜。

translations.literal: The ritual protocol officer intoned: "Bow twice."
translations.idiomatic: The ritual protocol officer called out: "Bow twice."

sentences.zh: 」在位者皆再拜。

translations.literal: All those in position bowed twice.
translations.idiomatic: Everyone in position bowed twice.

sentences.zh: 次引告官以下詣望燎位，執事者取幣帛祝版置於燎，禮直官曰：「可燎。

translations.literal: Next the announcing official and those below him were led to the station for viewing the burning offering; attendants took the silks and prayer tablets and placed them on the pyre; the ritual protocol officer said: "The pyre may be lit."
translations.idiomatic: Next the announcing official and his party were led to the burning-offering station; attendants placed the silks and prayer tablets on the pyre, and the ritual protocol officer said: "Light the pyre."

sentences.zh: 」半柴，禮直官贊：「禮畢。

translations.literal: When half the firewood was consumed, the ritual protocol officer intoned: "The rite is complete."
translations.idiomatic: When half the firewood had burned, the ritual protocol officer announced: "The rite is complete."

sentences.zh: 」告官以下退。

translations.literal: The announcing official and those below him withdrew.
translations.idiomatic: The announcing official and his party withdrew.

sentences.zh: 署令闔廟門，瘞祝於坎。

translations.literal: The acting director closed the temple gates and buried the prayer tablets in the pit.
translations.idiomatic: The acting director closed the temple gates and buried the prayer tablets in the burial pit.

sentences.zh: 貞元四年正月，上尊號。

translations.literal: In the first month of the fourth year of Zhenyuan, an honorific title was bestowed.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of Zhenyuan 4, the emperor received an honorific title.

sentences.zh: 前三日，遣使奏告天地，于常武殿拜天臺設褥位，昊天上帝居中，皇地祇居西少卻，行一獻禮。

translations.literal: Three days before, envoys were dispatched to present memorial announcements to Heaven and Earth; at the sky-worship terrace in Changwu Hall mats were set out, with the Supreme Lord of High Heaven in the center and the Imperial Earth Spirit slightly withdrawn to the west, and a single-offering rite was performed.
translations.idiomatic: Three days beforehand, envoys were sent to announce to Heaven and Earth. At the sky-worship terrace in Changwu Hall, mats were laid out with the Supreme Lord of High Heaven in the center and the Imperial Earth Spirit slightly to the west, and a single-offering rite was performed.

sentences.zh: 大定七年正月十三日，上尊號。

translations.literal: On the thirteenth day of the first month of the seventh year of Dading, an honorific title was bestowed.
translations.idiomatic: On the 13th day of the first month of Dading 7, the emperor received an honorific title.

sentences.zh: 前三日，命皇子判大興尹許王告天地，判宗正英王文告太廟。

translations.literal: Three days before, the prince who served as acting mayor of Daxing, Prince Xu, was ordered to announce to Heaven and Earth, and the prince who served as acting director of the imperial clan, Prince Ying, was ordered to announce to the Grand Ancestral Temple.
translations.idiomatic: Three days beforehand, Prince Xu, who served as acting mayor of Daxing, was ordered to announce to Heaven and Earth, and Prince Ying, who served as acting director of the imperial clan, was ordered to announce to the Grand Ancestral Temple.

sentences.zh: 於自來拜天處設昊天上帝位，當中南向，皇地祇位次西少卻，並用坐褥位牌及香酒脯臡等。

translations.literal: At the customary place for worshipping Heaven, seats were set for the Supreme Lord of High Heaven in the center facing south, and for the Imperial Earth Spirit slightly withdrawn to the west; seated mats, name tablets, incense, wine, dried meat, and minced meat were all provided.
translations.idiomatic: At the customary sky-worship site, seats were set for the Supreme Lord of High Heaven in the center facing south and for the Imperial Earth Spirit slightly to the west, furnished with seated mats, name tablets, incense, wine, dried meat, and minced meat.

sentences.zh: 祝版三，學士院撰告祝文，書寫訖，進請禦署，訖，以付禮部，移文宣徽院，並差控鶴官用案舁，覆以黃羅帕，隨所差告官詣祀所。

translations.literal: Three prayer tablets: the Academy of Scholarly Attendants drafted the announcement prayers, and when the writing was finished they were submitted for the imperial signature; when finished they were delivered to the Ministry of Rites, which sent documents to the Palace Domestic Service, and crane-guard officers were assigned to carry them on tables covered with yellow silk cloth, accompanying the assigned announcing officials to the place of sacrifice.
translations.idiomatic: Three prayer tablets were prepared: the Academy drafted the announcement prayers, and once copied they were submitted for the emperor's signature, then delivered to the Ministry of Rites, which notified the Palace Domestic Service. Crane-guard officers carried them on tables draped in yellow silk, accompanying the assigned announcing officials to the sacrificial site.

sentences.zh: 前一日，告官等就局所致齋一日。

translations.literal: On the previous day, the announcing officials observed ritual purification for one day at their bureaus.
translations.idiomatic: On the eve of the rite, the announcing officials observed ritual purification for a full day at their respective bureaus.

sentences.zh: 告日質明，宣徽院、太常寺鋪設供具如儀。

translations.literal: At dawn on the announcement day, the Palace Domestic Service and the Court of Imperial Sacrifices set out the offerings according to the rite.
translations.idiomatic: At dawn on announcement day, the Palace Domestic Service and the Court of Imperial Sacrifices set out the offerings according to prescribed procedure.

sentences.zh: 閣門舍人一員、太常博士一員引告官各服其服，以次就位。

translations.literal: One gatehouse attendant and one court of sacrifices doctor led the announcing officials, each in his proper robes, to take their places in order.
translations.idiomatic: A gatehouse attendant and a Court of Sacrifices doctor led the announcing officials, each in his proper robes, to their stations in order.

sentences.zh: 禮直官、舍人稍前，贊：「有司謹具，請行事。

translations.literal: The ritual protocol officer and attendant stepped slightly forward and intoned: "The officials have duly prepared; please proceed with the rite."
translations.idiomatic: The ritual protocol officer and attendant stepped forward and announced: "The officials have made all preparations; please proceed with the rite."

sentences.zh: 」贊者曰：「拜。

translations.literal: The intoner said: "Bow."
translations.idiomatic: The announcer called out: "Bow."

sentences.zh: 」在位者皆再拜。

translations.literal: All those in position bowed twice.
translations.idiomatic: Everyone in position bowed twice.

sentences.zh: 禮直官先引執事官各就位。

translations.literal: The ritual protocol officer first led the attendant officials each to his place.
translations.idiomatic: The ritual protocol officer first led the attendant officials to their stations.

sentences.zh: 舍人博士次引告官詣盥洗、爵洗位，北向立，搢笏，盥手，帨手，洗爵，拭爵。

translations.literal: The attendant and doctor next led the announcing officials to the hand-washing and goblet-washing stations; they stood facing north, inserted their tablets, washed their hands, dried their hands, washed the goblets, and wiped the goblets.
translations.idiomatic: The attendant and doctor then led the announcing officials to the hand-washing and goblet-washing stations, where they stood facing north, inserted their tablets, washed and dried their hands, and washed and wiped the goblets.

sentences.zh: 執笏，詣酒尊所，搢笏，執爵，司尊者舉冪酌酒，告官以爵授奉爵酒官，執笏詣昊天上帝，皇地祇神位前再拜，每位三上香，跪奠酒，訖，以爵授奉爵官，執笏，俯伏，興。

translations.literal: Holding their tablets, they went to the wine vessel, inserted their tablets, took the goblets; the vessel attendants lifted the covers and poured wine; the announcing officials handed the goblets to the wine-offering attendants, took their tablets, went before the spirit seats of the Supreme Lord of High Heaven and the Imperial Earth Spirit and bowed twice, at each seat offered incense three times, knelt and presented wine; when finished they handed the goblets to the wine attendants, took their tablets, prostrated themselves, and rose.
translations.idiomatic: Tablet in hand, they went to the wine vessel, inserted their tablets, and took the goblets while attendants poured the wine. They handed the goblets to the wine-offering attendants, then went before the seats of the Supreme Lord of High Heaven and the Imperial Earth Spirit, bowed twice at each, offered incense three times, knelt and presented wine, handed the goblets back, took their tablets, prostrated themselves, and rose.

sentences.zh: 舉祝官跪舉，讀訖，俯伏，興。

translations.literal: The prayer-lifter knelt and raised the prayer; when the reading was finished, he prostrated himself and rose.
translations.idiomatic: The prayer-lifter knelt, raised the prayer, and read it; when finished, he prostrated himself and rose.

sentences.zh: 告官再拜。

translations.literal: The announcing officials bowed twice.
translations.idiomatic: The announcing officials bowed twice.

sentences.zh: 告畢。

translations.literal: The announcement was complete.
translations.idiomatic: The announcement was complete.

sentences.zh: 引告官以下降復位，再拜，訖，詣望燎位，燔祝版，再拜。

translations.literal: The announcing officials and those below them were led down to return to their places and bowed twice; when finished, they went to the station for viewing the burning offering, burned the prayer tablets, and bowed twice.
translations.idiomatic: The announcing officials and their party were led down, returned to their stations, and bowed twice; then they went to the burning-offering station, burned the prayer tablets, and bowed twice again.

sentences.zh: 半燎，告官已下皆退。

translations.literal: When half the pyre was consumed, the announcing officials and those below them all withdrew.
translations.idiomatic: When half the pyre had burned, the announcing officials and their party all withdrew.

sentences.zh: 皇帝恭謝儀

translations.literal: Rite of the Emperor's Reverent Thanksgiving
translations.idiomatic: The Emperor's Rite of Reverent Thanksgiving

sentences.zh: 大定七年正月，世宗受尊號，禮畢恭謝。

translations.literal: In the first month of the seventh year of Dading, Shizong received an honorific title; when the rite was finished he performed reverent thanksgiving.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of Dading 7, Shizong received an honorific title and, when the ceremony was complete, performed the rite of reverent thanksgiving.

sentences.zh: 前三日，太廟令帥其屬，灑掃廟庭之內外及陳設。

translations.literal: Three days before, the director of the Grand Ancestral Temple led his subordinates in sprinkling and sweeping inside and outside the temple courtyard and in setting out the furnishings.
translations.idiomatic: Three days beforehand, the director of the Grand Ancestral Temple led his staff in sprinkling and sweeping the temple courtyard inside and out and in arranging the furnishings.

sentences.zh: 尚舍于廟南門之西，設饌幔一十一室。

translations.literal: The Palace Provisioners, west of the temple's south gate, set out food curtains for eleven chambers.
translations.idiomatic: West of the temple's south gate, the Palace Provisioners set out food curtains for eleven shrine chambers.

sentences.zh: 殿中監帥尚舍視大次殿，又設皇帝版位於始祖神位前北向，又設飲福位於版位西南少卻，又設隨室奠拜褥位於神座前。

translations.literal: The director of palace attendants led the provisioners in inspecting the great side hall; the emperor's tablet seat was also set before the founding ancestor's spirit seat facing north; a seat for drinking the blessing was set slightly southwest of the tablet seat; and mats for offering and bowing at each chamber were set before the spirit seats.
translations.idiomatic: The director of palace attendants led the provisioners in inspecting the great side hall. The emperor's tablet seat was placed before the founding ancestor's spirit seat facing north; a seat for drinking the blessing was set slightly to its southwest; and offering mats were placed before each spirit seat for per-chamber rites.

sentences.zh: 大樂令設登歌於殿上，宮縣于殿下。

translations.literal: The director of great music set the elevated singers on the hall and the palace musicians below the hall.
translations.idiomatic: The director of great music stationed the elevated singers in the hall and the palace musicians below it.

sentences.zh: 又設皇太之位於阼階東南，又設親王位於其南稍東，宗室王使相位於其後。

translations.literal: The crown prince's seat was also set southeast of the east steps; princes' seats were set slightly east to the south of that; imperial clansmen, princes, envoys, and chancellors were set behind them.
translations.idiomatic: The crown prince's seat was placed southeast of the east steps, with princes' seats slightly farther south and east, and imperial clansmen, princes, envoys, and chancellors behind them.

sentences.zh: 又設太尉、司徒以下行事官位於殿西階之西，東向，每等異位。

translations.literal: Seats for the Grand Commandant, Minister over the Masses, and other officiating officials below them were also set west of the hall's west steps, facing east, each rank in a separate place.
translations.idiomatic: Seats for the Grand Commandant, Minister over the Masses, and other officiating officials were placed west of the hall's west steps, facing east, each rank in its own station.

sentences.zh: 又設文武群官位於橫階之南，東、西向。

translations.literal: Seats for the civil and military officials were also set south of the cross steps, facing east and west.
translations.idiomatic: Seats for the civil and military officials were placed south of the cross steps, facing east and west.

sentences.zh: 又設禦洗位於阼階之東，又設太尉洗位於西階下橫階之南。

translations.literal: An imperial hand-washing station was also set east of the east steps, and a Grand Commandant hand-washing station south of the cross steps below the west steps.
translations.idiomatic: An imperial hand-washing station was set east of the east steps, and a Grand Commandant hand-washing station south of the cross steps below the west steps.

sentences.zh: 又設齋郎位於東班群官之後，又設盥洗等官、並奉禮、贊者、大司樂、協律郎、大樂令等位，各如祫享之儀。

translations.literal: Seats for the ritual attendants were also set behind the eastern rank of officials; stations for hand-washing officials, ritual attendants, intoners, the director of the imperial music office, pitch regulators, and the director of great music were all set as in the xia offering rite.
translations.idiomatic: Seats for the ritual attendants were placed behind the eastern rank of officials, and stations for hand-washing officials, ritual attendants, announcers, the director of the imperial music office, pitch regulators, and the director of great music were arranged as in the xia offering rite.

sentences.zh: 又設尊彝祭器等於殿之上下，如時享之儀。

translations.literal: Sacrificial vessels and offering implements were also set above and below the hall, as in the seasonal offering rite.
translations.idiomatic: Sacrificial vessels and offering implements were set in the hall and below it, following the seasonal offering procedure.

sentences.zh: 前一日，禮官禦史帥其屬，省牲、視濯滌，如常儀。

translations.literal: On the previous day, the ritual official and imperial censor led their subordinates in inspecting the sacrificial animals and overseeing washing and purification, as in the usual rite.
translations.idiomatic: On the eve of the rite, the ritual official and imperial censor led their staff in inspecting the sacrificial animals and overseeing washing and purification, as usual.

sentences.zh: 其日質明，禮官禦史帥太廟官、太祝官、宮闈令出神主，如時享儀。

translations.literal: At dawn that day, the ritual official and imperial censor led the temple officials, chief invokers, and palace gate directors in bringing out the spirit tablets, as in the seasonal offering rite.
translations.idiomatic: At dawn that day, the ritual official and imperial censor led the temple officials, chief invokers, and palace gate directors to bring out the spirit tablets, following the seasonal offering procedure.

sentences.zh: 有司列黃麾仗二千人于應天門外。

translations.literal: The relevant officials arrayed two thousand yellow-banner guards outside the Gate of Responding to Heaven.
translations.idiomatic: Officials arrayed two thousand yellow-banner guards outside the Gate of Responding to Heaven.

sentences.zh: 尚輦進金輅于應天門內。

translations.literal: The imperial carriage office brought the golden chariot inside the Gate of Responding to Heaven.
translations.idiomatic: The imperial carriage office brought the golden chariot inside the Gate of Responding to Heaven.

sentences.zh: 午後三刻、宣徽院奏請皇帝赴齋宿殿，文武群官並齋宿于所司。

translations.literal: At the third quarter after noon, the Palace Domestic Service memorialized requesting the emperor to go to the fasting quarters; civil and military officials likewise fasted overnight at their respective offices.
translations.idiomatic: At the third quarter after noon, the Palace Domestic Service requested that the emperor proceed to the fasting quarters, and civil and military officials likewise observed overnight fasting at their respective offices.

sentences.zh: 次日質明，俟諸衛各勒所部屯門列仗。

translations.literal: At dawn the next day, they waited for each guard command to muster its unit, garrison the gates, and array the guards of honor.
translations.idiomatic: At dawn the next day, each guard command mustered its troops, garrisoned the gates, and arrayed the guards of honor.

sentences.zh: 導駕官分左右侍立於殿階下，並朝服。

translations.literal: The procession guides stood left and right below the hall steps, all in court dress.
translations.idiomatic: The procession guides stood to the left and right below the hall steps, all in court dress.

sentences.zh: 通事舍人引侍中詣齋殿，俯伏，跪稱：」臣某言，請中嚴。

translations.literal: The communications attendant led the chief minister to the fasting hall; he prostrated himself, knelt, and said: "Your servant so-and-so reports: I request the middle vigil."
translations.idiomatic: The communications attendant led the chief minister to the fasting hall, where he prostrated himself, knelt, and said: "Your servant reports: I request the middle vigil."

sentences.zh: 」俯伏，興。

translations.literal: He prostrated himself and rose.
translations.idiomatic: He prostrated himself and rose.

sentences.zh: 凡侍中奏請，准此。

translations.literal: All petitions by the chief minister followed this pattern.
translations.idiomatic: All petitions by the chief minister followed this pattern.

sentences.zh: 皇帝服通天冠、絳紗袍。

translations.literal: The emperor wore the Tongtian crown and crimson gauze robe.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor wore the Tongtian crown and crimson gauze robe.

sentences.zh: 少頃，侍中奏：「外辦。

translations.literal: After a short while, the chief minister memorialized: "The outer preparations are complete."
translations.idiomatic: Shortly afterward, the chief minister reported: "The outer preparations are complete."

sentences.zh: 」皇帝出齋殿。

translations.literal: The emperor left the fasting hall.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor left the fasting hall.

sentences.zh: 即御座，群官起居訖，侍中奏：「請升輦。

translations.literal: He immediately took the imperial seat; when the officials had finished their salutations, the chief minister memorialized: "I request that Your Majesty ascend the palanquin."
translations.idiomatic: He took the imperial seat, and after the officials had finished their salutations the chief minister reported: "I request that Your Majesty ascend the palanquin."

sentences.zh: 」皇帝升輦以出，侍衛警蹕如常儀。

translations.literal: The emperor ascended the palanquin and departed; the guards cleared the way with warnings as in the usual rite.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor ascended the palanquin and departed, while the guards cleared the way with warnings as usual.

sentences.zh: 導駕官前導，至應天門，侍中奏：「請降輦升輅。

translations.literal: The procession guides led the way; arriving at the Gate of Responding to Heaven, the chief minister memorialized: "I request that Your Majesty descend from the palanquin and ascend the chariot."
translations.idiomatic: The procession guides led the way to the Gate of Responding to Heaven, where the chief minister reported: "I request that Your Majesty descend from the palanquin and ascend the chariot."

sentences.zh: 」皇帝升輅，門下侍郎俯伏，跪奏：「請車駕進發。

translations.literal: The emperor ascended the chariot; the vice minister of the gate prostrated himself, knelt, and memorialized: "I request that the imperial procession depart."
translations.idiomatic: The emperor ascended the chariot. The vice minister of the gate prostrated himself, knelt, and reported: "I request that the imperial procession depart."

sentences.zh: 」俯伏，興。

translations.literal: He prostrated himself and rose.
translations.idiomatic: He prostrated himself and rose.

sentences.zh: 凡門下侍郎奏請，准此。

translations.literal: All petitions by the vice minister of the gate followed this pattern.
translations.idiomatic: All petitions by the vice minister of the gate followed this pattern.

sentences.zh: 車駕動，警蹕如常儀。

translations.literal: The imperial procession moved; the way was cleared with warnings as in the usual rite.
translations.idiomatic: The imperial procession moved off, and the way was cleared with warnings as usual.

sentences.zh: 至應天門外，門下侍郎奏：「請車駕少駐，敕侍臣上馬。

translations.literal: Outside the Gate of Responding to Heaven, the vice minister of the gate memorialized: "I request that the imperial procession halt briefly and command the attending officials to mount their horses."
translations.idiomatic: Outside the Gate of Responding to Heaven, the vice minister of the gate reported: "I request that the procession halt briefly and command the attending officials to mount their horses."

sentences.zh: 」侍中前承旨，退稱曰：「制可。

translations.literal: The chief minister stepped forward to receive the edict, withdrew, and said: "The decree is approved."
translations.idiomatic: The chief minister stepped forward to receive the edict, withdrew, and announced: "The decree is approved."

sentences.zh: 」門下侍郎退，傳制稱：「侍臣上馬。

translations.literal: The vice minister of the gate withdrew and transmitted the decree: "Attending officials, mount your horses."
translations.idiomatic: The vice minister of the gate withdrew and transmitted the decree: "Attending officials, mount your horses."

sentences.zh: 」通事舍人承傳：「敕侍臣上馬。

translations.literal: The communications attendant received and transmitted: "By imperial command, attending officials are to mount their horses."
translations.idiomatic: The communications attendant received and transmitted the order: "By imperial command, attending officials are to mount their horses."

sentences.zh: 」導駕官分左右前導，門下侍郎奏：「請車駕進發」。

translations.literal: The procession guides led the way left and right; the vice minister of the gate memorialized: "I request that the imperial procession depart."
translations.idiomatic: The procession guides led the way on either side, and the vice minister of the gate reported: "I request that the imperial procession depart."

sentences.zh: 車駕動，稱：「警蹕。

translations.literal: The imperial procession moved; the cry went up: "Clear the way!"
translations.idiomatic: The procession moved off, and the cry went up: "Clear the way!"

sentences.zh: 」不鳴鼓吹。

translations.literal: Drums and pipes were not sounded.
translations.idiomatic: Drums and pipes were not sounded.

sentences.zh: 典贊儀引皇太子常服乘馬至廟中幕次，更服遠遊冠、硃明衣，執圭。

translations.literal: The master of ceremonial led the crown prince in ordinary dress on horseback to the tent at the temple, where he changed into the distant-travel crown, vermilion bright robe, and took the scepter.
translations.idiomatic: The master of ceremonial led the crown prince in ordinary dress on horseback to the tent at the temple, where he changed into the distant-travel crown and vermilion bright robe and took up the scepter.

sentences.zh: 通事舍人文武群官並朝服於廟門外班迎。

translations.literal: The communications attendant and all civil and military officials in court dress formed ranks outside the temple gate to welcome the procession.
translations.idiomatic: The communications attendant and all civil and military officials in court dress formed ranks outside the temple gate to welcome the procession.

sentences.zh: 車駕至廟門，侍中於輅前奏：「請降輅。

translations.literal: When the imperial procession reached the temple gate, the chief minister memorialized before the chariot: "I request that Your Majesty descend from the chariot."
translations.idiomatic: When the procession reached the temple gate, the chief minister reported before the chariot: "I request that Your Majesty descend from the chariot."

sentences.zh: 」導駕官步入廟門稍東，侍中奏：「請升輦。

translations.literal: The procession guides entered the temple gate slightly to the east; the chief minister memorialized: "I request that Your Majesty ascend the palanquin."
translations.idiomatic: The procession guides entered the temple gate slightly to the east, and the chief minister reported: "I request that Your Majesty ascend the palanquin."

sentences.zh: 」皇帝升輦，傘扇侍衛如常儀。

translations.literal: The emperor ascended the palanquin; parasols, fans, and attendants guarded him as in the usual rite.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor ascended the palanquin, with parasols, fans, and guards attending as usual.

sentences.zh: 至大次，侍中奏：「請降輦，入就大次。

translations.literal: Reaching the great side hall, the chief minister memorialized: "I request that Your Majesty descend from the palanquin and enter the great side hall.
translations.idiomatic: When they reached the great side hall, the chief minister reported: "I request that Your Majesty descend from the palanquin and enter the great side hall.

sentences.zh: 」皇帝入大次。

translations.literal: The emperor entered the great side hall.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor entered the great side hall.

sentences.zh: 通事舍人分引文武群官由南神東西偏門入廟庭，東西相向立。

translations.literal: The communications attendant led civil and military officials in separate groups through the east and west side gates of the south spirit gate into the temple courtyard, where they stood facing one another east and west.
translations.idiomatic: The communications attendant led the civil and military officials in groups through the eastern and western side gates of the south spirit gate into the temple courtyard, where they stood facing one another from east and west.

sentences.zh: 禮直官引太尉以下行事官詣橫街北向，再拜，訖，禮直官引太尉詣盥洗位，搢笏，盥手，帨手，執笏，詣爵洗位，北向立，搢笏，洗瓚，拭瓚，以瓚授執事者，執笏，由西階升殿，詣始祖尊彝所，西向立。

translations.literal: The ritual protocol officer led the Grand Commandant and other officiating officials below him to the cross street, where they faced north and bowed twice; when finished, the ritual protocol officer led the Grand Commandant to the hand-washing station, where he inserted his tablet, washed his hands, dried them with a towel, took his tablet, went to the goblet-washing station, stood facing north, inserted his tablet, washed the libation cup, wiped the libation cup, handed the cup to the attendants, took his tablet, ascended the hall by the west steps, went to the place of the founding ancestor's sacrificial vessel, and stood facing west.
translations.idiomatic: The ritual protocol officer led the Grand Commandant and the officiating officials below him to the cross street, where they faced north and bowed twice. Then he led the Grand Commandant to the hand-washing station to insert his tablet, wash and dry his hands, take up his tablet again, and proceed to the goblet-washing station. There the Grand Commandant faced north, inserted his tablet, washed and wiped the jade libation cup, handed it to the attendants, took his tablet, ascended by the west steps, and stood facing west at the founding ancestor's sacrificial vessel.

sentences.zh: 執事者以瓚奉太尉，太尉搢笏，執瓚酌鬯，詣神位前，以鬯稞地，訖，以虛瓚授執事者，執笏，俯伏，興，出戶外北向，再拜，訖。

translations.literal: The attendants presented the libation cup to the Grand Commandant; the Grand Commandant inserted his tablet, took the cup, poured fragrant libation wine, went before the spirit seat, sprinkled the wine on the ground, and when finished handed the empty cup to the attendants; he took his tablet, prostrated himself, rose, went outside the door and faced north, bowed twice, and when finished.
translations.idiomatic: The attendants presented the libation cup to the Grand Commandant. He inserted his tablet, took the cup, poured fragrant libation wine, and went before the spirit seat to sprinkle it on the ground. When finished, he handed the empty cup back to the attendants, took his tablet, prostrated himself, rose, withdrew outside the door, faced north, and bowed twice.

sentences.zh: 次詣隨室並如上儀。

translations.literal: Next he went to each attendant chamber and performed the rite as above.
translations.idiomatic: He then proceeded to each attendant chamber and performed the same rite.

sentences.zh: 禮畢，降自西階，復位。

translations.literal: When the rite was finished, he descended by the west steps and returned to his place.
translations.idiomatic: When the rite was complete, he descended by the west steps and returned to his station.

sentences.zh: 禮直官引司徒出詣饌所，引薦俎齋郎奉俎、並薦籩豆簠簋官奉籩豆簠簋，及太官令，以序入自正門，宮縣樂作，至大階，樂止。

translations.literal: The ritual protocol officer led the Minister over the Masses out to the food station and led the ritual attendants presenting the meat stands, officials presenting baskets, trays, and grain vessels, and the director of the imperial kitchen to enter in order through the main gate; palace music began, and when they reached the great steps it ceased.
translations.idiomatic: The ritual protocol officer led the Minister over the Masses out to the food station, then guided the attendants bearing meat stands, the officials bearing baskets, trays, and grain vessels, and the director of the imperial kitchen to enter in procession through the main gate. Palace music played until they reached the great steps, then ceased.

sentences.zh: 諸太祝迎於階上，各設於神座前。

translations.literal: The chief invokers welcomed them on the steps and set each offering before the spirit seats.
translations.idiomatic: The chief invokers met them on the steps and placed each offering before the spirit seats.

sentences.zh: 先薦牛，次薦羊，次薦豕，訖，禮直官引司徒已下降階復位。

translations.literal: The ox was presented first, then the sheep, then the pig; when finished, the ritual protocol officer led the Minister over the Masses, who had already descended the steps, back to his place.
translations.idiomatic: The ox was presented first, then the sheep, then the pig. When this was done, the ritual protocol officer led the Minister over the Masses, who had already descended the steps, back to his station.

sentences.zh: 典贊儀引皇太子，通事舍人引親王，由南神東偏門入，詣褥位。

translations.literal: The master of ceremonial led the crown prince, and the communications attendant led the princes through the east side gate of the south spirit gate to the mat seats.
translations.idiomatic: The master of ceremonial led the crown prince, and the communications attendant led the princes through the east side gate of the south spirit gate to the mat seats.

sentences.zh: 禮直官引中書侍郎、舉冊官等升自西階，詣始祖室前，東西立。

translations.literal: The ritual protocol officer led the vice minister of the secretariat, the tablet-bearers, and others to ascend by the west steps and go before the founding ancestor's chamber, where they stood east and west.
translations.idiomatic: The ritual protocol officer led the vice minister of the secretariat, the tablet-bearers, and others up the west steps to stand east and west before the founding ancestor's chamber.

sentences.zh: 通事舍人引侍中詣大次前，奏：「請中嚴。

translations.literal: The communications attendant led the chief minister before the great side hall and he memorialized: "I request strict silence within.
translations.idiomatic: The communications attendant led the chief minister before the great side hall, where he reported: "I request strict silence within.

sentences.zh: 」皇帝服袞冕。

translations.literal: The emperor put on ceremonial robes and crown.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor donned his ceremonial robes and crown.

sentences.zh: 少頃，侍中奏：「外辦。

translations.literal: After a short while, the chief minister memorialized: "The outer preparations are complete.
translations.idiomatic: After a short while, the chief minister reported: "The outer preparations are complete.

sentences.zh: 」侍中詣廟庭本位立，皇帝將出大次，禮儀使與太常卿贊導。

translations.literal: The chief minister went to his proper place in the temple courtyard and stood; as the emperor was about to leave the great side hall, the ritual protocol commissioner and the director of the imperial ancestral temple office guided and intoned.
translations.idiomatic: The chief minister took his station in the temple courtyard. As the emperor was about to leave the great side hall, the ritual protocol commissioner and the director of the imperial ancestral temple office guided and announced the rites.

sentences.zh: 凡禮儀使與太常卿贊導，並博士前引，俯伏，跪稱：「臣某贊導皇帝行禮。

translations.literal: Whenever the ritual protocol commissioner and the director of the imperial ancestral temple office guided and intoned, together with the ceremonial masters leading the way, they prostrated themselves, knelt, and said: "Your subject so-and-so guides and directs the emperor in performing the rite.
translations.idiomatic: Whenever the ritual protocol commissioner and the director of the imperial ancestral temple office guided the emperor, the ceremonial masters led the way while they prostrated themselves, knelt, and said: "Your subject [name] guides the emperor through the rite.

sentences.zh: 」俯伏，興。

translations.literal: They prostrated themselves and rose.
translations.idiomatic: They prostrated themselves and rose.

sentences.zh: 前導至東神門，撤傘扇，近侍者從入。

translations.literal: They led the way to the east spirit gate, where parasols and fans were removed; close attendants followed inside.
translations.idiomatic: They led the way to the east spirit gate, where parasols and fans were withdrawn, and close attendants followed inside.

sentences.zh: 殿中監跪進鎮圭，禮儀使奏：「請執圭。

translations.literal: The director of palace attendants knelt and presented the imperial scepter; the ritual protocol commissioner memorialized: "I request that Your Majesty take the scepter.
translations.idiomatic: The director of palace attendants knelt and presented the imperial scepter. The ritual protocol commissioner announced: "I request that Your Majesty take the scepter.

sentences.zh: 」皇帝執圭，宮縣樂作。

translations.literal: The emperor took the scepter, and palace music began.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor took the scepter, and palace music began.

sentences.zh: 奏：「請詣罍洗位。

translations.literal: He memorialized: "I request that Your Majesty proceed to the jar-washing station.
translations.idiomatic: He announced: "I request that Your Majesty proceed to the jar-washing station.

sentences.zh: 」至位，樂止。

translations.literal: Reaching the station, the music ceased.
translations.idiomatic: When they reached the station, the music ceased.

sentences.zh: 內侍跪取匜，興，沃水。

translations.literal: A palace attendant knelt, took the ewer, rose, and poured water.
translations.idiomatic: A palace attendant knelt, took the ewer, rose, and poured water.

sentences.zh: 又內侍跪取槃，承水。

translations.literal: Another palace attendant knelt, took the basin, and caught the water.
translations.idiomatic: Another palace attendant knelt, took the basin, and caught the water.

sentences.zh: 時寒，預備溫水。

translations.literal: Because of the cold season, warm water was prepared in advance.
translations.idiomatic: Because it was cold, warm water had been prepared in advance.

sentences.zh: 禮儀使奏：「請搢鎮圭。

translations.literal: The ritual protocol commissioner memorialized: "I request that Your Majesty insert the imperial scepter.
translations.idiomatic: The ritual protocol commissioner announced: "I request that Your Majesty insert the imperial scepter.

sentences.zh: 」皇帝搢鎮圭，盥手。

translations.literal: The emperor inserted the imperial scepter and washed his hands.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor tucked the imperial scepter into his belt and washed his hands.

sentences.zh: 內侍跪取巾於篚，興，進，皇帝帨手，訖，奉爵官以爵跪進，皇帝受爵，內侍捧匜沃水，又內侍跪捧槃承水，皇帝洗爵，訖，內侍跪奉巾以進，皇帝拭爵，訖，內侍奠槃匜，又奠巾於篚。

translations.literal: A palace attendant knelt, took a towel from the basket, rose, and presented it; the emperor dried his hands, and when finished the goblet-bearer knelt and presented the goblet; the emperor received the goblet; a palace attendant held the ewer and poured water; another palace attendant knelt and held the basin to catch the water; the emperor washed the goblet, and when finished a palace attendant knelt and presented a towel; the emperor wiped the goblet, and when finished the palace attendants set down the basin and ewer and placed the towel back in the basket.
translations.idiomatic: A palace attendant knelt, took a towel from the basket, rose, and presented it, and the emperor dried his hands. The goblet-bearer then knelt and presented the goblet, which the emperor received. A palace attendant poured water from the ewer while another knelt to catch it in the basin, and the emperor washed the goblet. When he had finished, an attendant presented a towel; he wiped the goblet clean, and the attendants set down the basin and ewer and returned the towel to the basket.

sentences.zh: 奉爵官受爵。

translations.literal: The goblet-bearer received the goblet.
translations.idiomatic: The goblet-bearer received the goblet.

sentences.zh: 禮儀使奏：「請執鎮圭。

translations.literal: The ritual protocol commissioner memorialized: "I request that Your Majesty take the imperial scepter.
translations.idiomatic: The ritual protocol commissioner announced: "I request that Your Majesty take the imperial scepter.

sentences.zh: 」前導皇帝升殿，左右侍從量人數升，宮縣樂作。

translations.literal: They led the emperor up to the hall; attendants to left and right ascended according to their numbers; palace music began.
translations.idiomatic: They led the emperor up to the hall, with attendants on either side ascending according to their ranks, while palace music played.

sentences.zh: 皇帝至阼階下，樂止。

translations.literal: When the emperor reached the foot of the east steps, the music ceased.
translations.idiomatic: When the emperor reached the foot of the east steps, the music ceased.

sentences.zh: 皇帝升自阼階，登歌樂作。

translations.literal: The emperor ascended by the east steps, and the elevated singers' music began.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor ascended by the east steps as the elevated singers' music began.

sentences.zh: 禮儀使前導，皇帝至版位，樂止。

translations.literal: The ritual protocol commissioner led the way; when the emperor reached the tablet seat, the music ceased.
translations.idiomatic: The ritual protocol commissioner led the way until the emperor reached the tablet seat, where the music ceased.

sentences.zh: 奏：「請再拜。

translations.literal: He memorialized: "I request that Your Majesty bow twice.
translations.idiomatic: He announced: "I request that Your Majesty bow twice.

sentences.zh: 」奉禮郎贊：「皇太子已下在位群官皆再拜。

translations.literal: The ritual attendant intoned: "The crown prince and all officials in position below him shall bow twice.
translations.idiomatic: The ritual attendant called out: "The crown prince and all officials present shall bow twice.

sentences.zh: 」贊者承傳，皆再拜。

translations.literal: The intoners relayed the call, and all bowed twice.
translations.idiomatic: The announcers relayed the command, and all bowed twice.

sentences.zh: 禮儀使前導，皇帝詣始祖尊彝所，樂作，至尊所，樂止。

translations.literal: The ritual protocol commissioner led the way as the emperor went to the place of the founding ancestor's sacrificial vessel; music began, and when he reached the vessel-place the music ceased.
translations.idiomatic: The ritual protocol commissioner led the emperor to the founding ancestor's sacrificial vessel; music played until he reached the vessel, then ceased.

sentences.zh: 奉爵官以爵蒞尊，執尊者舉冪，侍中跪酌犧尊之泛齊，訖，禮儀使導皇帝至版位，再拜，訖，禮儀使奏：「請詣始祖神位前褥位。

translations.literal: The goblet-bearer brought the goblet to the vessel; the vessel attendant lifted the cover; the chief minister knelt and poured second-fermentation wine from the sacrifice vessel; when finished, the ritual protocol commissioner led the emperor to the tablet seat, where he bowed twice; when finished, the ritual protocol commissioner memorialized: "I request that Your Majesty proceed to the mat seat before the founding ancestor's spirit seat.
translations.idiomatic: The goblet-bearer brought the goblet to the vessel, the vessel attendant lifted the cover, and the chief minister knelt to pour second-fermentation wine from the sacrifice vessel. When this was done, the ritual protocol commissioner led the emperor back to the tablet seat to bow twice, then announced: "I request that Your Majesty proceed to the mat seat before the founding ancestor's spirit seat.

sentences.zh: 」登歌樂作。

translations.literal: The elevated singers' music began.
translations.idiomatic: The elevated singers' music began.

sentences.zh: 禮儀使奏：「請搢圭。

translations.literal: The ritual protocol commissioner memorialized: "I request that Your Majesty insert the scepter.
translations.idiomatic: The ritual protocol commissioner announced: "I request that Your Majesty insert the scepter.

sentences.zh: 」跪，奉爵官以爵授奉爵酒官以進。

translations.literal: Kneeling, the goblet-bearer handed the goblet to the goblet-wine attendant to present.
translations.idiomatic: Kneeling, the goblet-bearer handed the goblet to the goblet-wine attendant to present.

sentences.zh: 禮儀使奏：「請執爵。

translations.literal: The ritual protocol commissioner memorialized: "I request that Your Majesty take the goblet.
translations.idiomatic: The ritual protocol commissioner announced: "I request that Your Majesty take the goblet.

sentences.zh: 」皇帝執爵，二奠酒，訖，以虛爵授奉爵酒官。

translations.literal: The emperor took the goblet and poured two libations; when finished, he handed the empty goblet to the goblet-wine attendant.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor took the goblet and poured two libations, then handed the empty goblet to the goblet-wine attendant.

sentences.zh: 禮儀使奏：「請執圭。

translations.literal: The ritual protocol commissioner memorialized: "I request that Your Majesty take the scepter.
translations.idiomatic: The ritual protocol commissioner announced: "I request that Your Majesty take the scepter.

sentences.zh: 」俯伏，興，樂止。

translations.literal: He prostrated himself and rose, and the music ceased.
translations.idiomatic: He prostrated himself and rose, and the music ceased.

sentences.zh: 奉爵酒官以爵授奉爵官。

translations.literal: The goblet-wine attendant handed the goblet back to the goblet-bearer.
translations.idiomatic: The goblet-wine attendant handed the goblet back to the goblet-bearer.

sentences.zh: 禮儀使奏：「請詣隨室。

translations.literal: The ritual protocol commissioner memorialized: "I request that Your Majesty proceed to the attendant chambers.
translations.idiomatic: The ritual protocol commissioner announced: "I request that Your Majesty proceed to the attendant chambers.

sentences.zh: 」並如上儀。

translations.literal: All were performed as in the rite above.
translations.idiomatic: The same rite was performed at each chamber.

sentences.zh: 禮直官先引司徒升自西階，立於飲福位之側，酌獻將畢，奉胙，酌福酒。

translations.literal: The ritual protocol officer first led the Minister over the Masses to ascend by the west steps and stand beside the seat for drinking the blessing; when the libations were nearly finished, he presented the sacrificial meat and poured the blessing wine.
translations.idiomatic: The ritual protocol officer first led the Minister over the Masses up the west steps to stand beside the seat for drinking the blessing; when the libations were nearly complete, he presented the sacrificial meat and poured the blessing wine.

sentences.zh: 太祝從司徒立於其側，酌獻畢，侍 中亦立於其側。

translations.literal: The chief invoker followed the Minister over the Masses and stood beside him; when the libations were finished, the chief minister also stood beside him.
translations.idiomatic: The chief invoker followed the Minister over the Masses and stood at his side; when the libations were finished, the chief minister took his place beside him as well.

sentences.zh: 禮儀使奏：「請皇帝詣版位。

translations.literal: The ritual protocol commissioner memorialized: "I request that the emperor proceed to the tablet seat.
translations.idiomatic: The ritual protocol commissioner announced: "I request that the emperor proceed to the tablet seat.

sentences.zh: 」北向立，登歌樂作，至位樂止。

translations.literal: Facing north he stood; the elevated singers' music began, and when he reached his place the music ceased.
translations.idiomatic: He stood facing north; the elevated singers' music played until he reached his place, then ceased.

sentences.zh: 中書侍郎跪讀冊，訖，舉冊官奠，訖，禮儀使奏：「請皇帝再拜。

translations.literal: The vice minister of the secretariat knelt and read the memorial tablet; when finished, the tablet-bearer set it down; when finished, the ritual protocol commissioner memorialized: "I request that the emperor bow twice.
translations.idiomatic: The vice minister of the secretariat knelt and read the memorial tablet. When the reading was finished, the tablet-bearer set it down, and the ritual protocol commissioner announced: "I request that the emperor bow twice.

sentences.zh: 」拜訖，禮儀使奏：「請詣飲福位。

translations.literal: When the bowing was finished, the ritual protocol commissioner memorialized: "I request that Your Majesty proceed to the seat for drinking the blessing.
translations.idiomatic: When the bowing was finished, the ritual protocol commissioner announced: "I request that Your Majesty proceed to the seat for drinking the blessing.

sentences.zh: 」登歌樂作。

translations.literal: The elevated singers' music began.
translations.idiomatic: The elevated singers' music began.

sentences.zh: 至位，太祝酌福酒于爵，時寒預備溫酒，以奉侍中，侍中受爵奉以立，禮儀使奏：「請搢圭。

translations.literal: Reaching his place, the chief invoker poured blessing wine into the goblet; because of the cold season warm wine was prepared in advance, and presented it to the chief minister, who received the goblet and stood holding it; the ritual protocol commissioner memorialized: "I request that Your Majesty insert the scepter.
translations.idiomatic: When he reached his place, the chief invoker poured blessing wine into the goblet—in the cold weather, warm wine had been prepared—and presented it to the chief minister, who received it and stood holding it. The ritual protocol commissioner announced: "I request that Your Majesty insert the scepter.

sentences.zh: 」跪，侍中以爵北向跪以進，禮儀使奏：「請執爵。

translations.literal: Kneeling, the chief minister faced north, knelt, and presented the goblet; the ritual protocol commissioner memorialized: "I request that Your Majesty take the goblet.
translations.idiomatic: Kneeling, the chief minister faced north and presented the goblet. The ritual protocol commissioner announced: "I request that Your Majesty take the goblet.

sentences.zh: 」三祭酒。

translations.literal: He poured three libations.
translations.idiomatic: He poured three libations.

sentences.zh: 禮儀使奏：「請飲福。

translations.literal: The ritual protocol commissioner memorialized: "I request that Your Majesty drink the blessing.
translations.idiomatic: The ritual protocol commissioner announced: "I request that Your Majesty drink the blessing.

sentences.zh: 」飲福訖，以虛爵授侍中。

translations.literal: When he had finished drinking the blessing, he handed the empty goblet to the chief minister.
translations.idiomatic: When he had finished drinking the blessing, he handed the empty goblet to the chief minister.

sentences.zh: 禮儀使奏：「請受胙。

translations.literal: The ritual protocol commissioner memorialized: "I request that Your Majesty receive the sacrificial meat.
translations.idiomatic: The ritual protocol commissioner announced: "I request that Your Majesty receive the sacrificial meat.

sentences.zh: 」司徒跪以黍稷飯籩進，皇帝受以授左右。

translations.literal: The Minister over the Masses knelt and presented a basket of millet and glutinous rice; the emperor received it and handed it to those at his side.
translations.idiomatic: The Minister over the Masses knelt and presented a basket of millet and glutinous rice; the emperor received it and passed it to his attendants.

sentences.zh: 司徒又跪以胙肉進，皇帝受以授左右。

translations.literal: The Minister over the Masses again knelt and presented sacrificial meat; the emperor received it and handed it to those at his side.
translations.idiomatic: The Minister over the Masses again knelt and presented sacrificial meat; the emperor received it and passed it to his attendants.

sentences.zh: 禮儀使奏：「請執圭。

translations.literal: The ritual protocol commissioner memorialized: "I request that Your Majesty take the scepter.
translations.idiomatic: The ritual protocol commissioner announced: "I request that Your Majesty take the scepter.

sentences.zh: 」興，再拜訖，樂止。

translations.literal: He rose, bowed twice, and when finished the music ceased.
translations.idiomatic: He rose, bowed twice, and the music ceased.

sentences.zh: 禮儀使前導，皇帝還版位，登歌樂作，至位樂止。

translations.literal: The ritual protocol commissioner led the way as the emperor returned to the tablet seat; the elevated singers' music began, and when he reached his place the music ceased.
translations.idiomatic: The ritual protocol commissioner led the emperor back to the tablet seat; the elevated singers' music played until he arrived, then ceased.

sentences.zh: 太祝各進徹籩豆，登歌樂作。

translations.literal: The chief invokers each advanced to remove the baskets and trays; the elevated singers' music began.
translations.idiomatic: The chief invokers each came forward to remove the baskets and trays as the elevated singers' music began.

sentences.zh: 卒徹，樂止。

translations.literal: When the removal was complete, the music ceased.
translations.idiomatic: When the removal was complete, the music ceased.

sentences.zh: 奉禮曰：「賜胙。

translations.literal: The ritual attendant said: "Sacrificial meat is bestowed.
translations.idiomatic: The ritual attendant announced: "Sacrificial meat is bestowed.

sentences.zh: 」贊：「皇太子已下在位群官皆再拜。

translations.literal: He intoned: "The crown prince and all officials in position below him shall bow twice.
translations.idiomatic: He called out: "The crown prince and all officials present shall bow twice.

sentences.zh: 」贊者承傳，皆再拜，宮縣作，一成止。

translations.literal: The intoners relayed the call, and all bowed twice; palace music played for one movement and ceased.
translations.idiomatic: The announcers relayed the command, and all bowed twice; palace music played one movement and ceased.

sentences.zh: 禮儀使奏：「請皇帝再拜。

translations.literal: The ritual protocol commissioner memorialized: "I request that the emperor bow twice.
translations.idiomatic: The ritual protocol commissioner announced: "I request that the emperor bow twice.

sentences.zh: 」奉禮郎贊：「皇太子已下在位官皆再拜。

translations.literal: The ritual attendant intoned: "The crown prince and all officials in position below him shall bow twice.
translations.idiomatic: The ritual attendant called out: "The crown prince and all officials present shall bow twice.

sentences.zh: 」拜訖，禮儀使奏：「禮畢。

translations.literal: When the bowing was finished, the ritual protocol commissioner memorialized: "The rite is complete.
translations.idiomatic: When the bowing was finished, the ritual protocol commissioner announced: "The rite is complete.

sentences.zh: 」前導皇帝降阼階，登歌樂作，至階下樂止。

translations.literal: They led the emperor down the east steps; the elevated singers' music began, and when he reached the foot of the steps the music ceased.
translations.idiomatic: They led the emperor down the east steps; the elevated singers' music played until he reached the foot of the steps, then ceased.

sentences.zh: 宮縣作，前導皇帝出東神門，樂止。

translations.literal: Palace music began; they led the emperor out through the east spirit gate, and the music ceased.
translations.idiomatic: Palace music began as they led the emperor out through the east spirit gate, then ceased.

sentences.zh: 傘扇侍衛如常儀。

translations.literal: Parasols, fans, and guards attended as in the usual rite.
translations.idiomatic: Parasols, fans, and guards attended as usual.

sentences.zh: 禮儀使奏：「請釋圭。

translations.literal: The ritual protocol commissioner memorialized: "I request that Your Majesty release the scepter.
translations.idiomatic: The ritual protocol commissioner announced: "I request that Your Majesty release the scepter.

sentences.zh: 」殿中監跪受鎮圭。

translations.literal: The director of palace attendants knelt and received the imperial scepter.
translations.idiomatic: The director of palace attendants knelt and received the imperial scepter.

sentences.zh: 至大次，轉仗衛於還途，如來儀。

translations.literal: Reaching the great side hall, the halberd guards were redeployed along the return route as on the outward journey.
translations.idiomatic: At the great side hall, the halberd guards were redeployed along the return route as on the way in.

sentences.zh: 禮宮禦史帥其屬，納神主，藏冊如儀。

translations.literal: The ritual official and imperial censor led their subordinates in storing the spirit tablets and putting away the memorial tablets according to the rite.
translations.idiomatic: The ritual official and imperial censor led their staff in storing the spirit tablets and putting away the memorial tablets as prescribed.

sentences.zh: 少頃，通事舍人引侍中奏：「請中嚴。

translations.literal: After a short while, the communications attendant led the chief minister, who memorialized: "I request strict silence within.
translations.idiomatic: After a short while, the communications attendant led the chief minister forward to report: "I request strict silence within.

sentences.zh: 」皇帝服通天冠、絳紗袍。

translations.literal: The emperor put on the open-through crown and crimson gauze robe.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor donned the open-through crown and crimson gauze robe.

sentences.zh: 少頃，侍中奏：「外辦。

translations.literal: After a short while, the chief minister memorialized: "The outer preparations are complete.
translations.idiomatic: After a short while, the chief minister reported: "The outer preparations are complete.

sentences.zh: 」俟尚輦進輦，侍中奏：「請降座升輦。

translations.literal: When the director of the palanquin had brought the palanquin forward, the chief minister memorialized: "I request that Your Majesty descend from the seat and ascend the palanquin.
translations.idiomatic: When the director of the palanquin had brought the palanquin forward, the chief minister reported: "I request that Your Majesty descend from the seat and ascend the palanquin.

sentences.zh: 」皇帝升輦，傘扇侍衛如常儀。

translations.literal: The emperor ascended the palanquin; parasols, fans, and guards attended as in the usual rite.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor ascended the palanquin, with parasols, fans, and guards attending as usual.

sentences.zh: 至南神門稍東，侍中奏：「請降輦步出廟門。

translations.literal: Reaching a point slightly east of the south spirit gate, the chief minister memorialized: "I request that Your Majesty descend from the palanquin and walk out through the temple gate.
translations.idiomatic: At a point slightly east of the south spirit gate, the chief minister reported: "I request that Your Majesty descend from the palanquin and walk out through the temple gate.

sentences.zh: 」皇帝步出廟門，至輅，侍中奏：「請升輅。

translations.literal: The emperor walked out through the temple gate; reaching the chariot, the chief minister memorialized: "I request that Your Majesty ascend the chariot.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor walked out through the temple gate, and when he reached the chariot the chief minister reported: "I request that Your Majesty ascend the chariot.

sentences.zh: 」皇帝升輅。

translations.literal: The emperor ascended the chariot.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor ascended the chariot.

sentences.zh: 門下侍郎奏：「請車駕少駐，敕侍臣上馬。

translations.literal: The vice minister of the gate memorialized: "I request that the imperial procession halt briefly and command the attending officials to mount their horses.
translations.idiomatic: The vice minister of the gate reported: "I request that the procession halt briefly and command the attending officials to mount their horses.

sentences.zh: 」侍中前承旨，退稱曰：「制可。

translations.literal: The chief minister stepped forward to receive the edict, withdrew, and said: "The decree is approved.
translations.idiomatic: The chief minister stepped forward to receive the edict, withdrew, and announced: "The decree is approved.

sentences.zh: 」門下侍郎退，傳制稱：「侍臣上馬。

translations.literal: The vice minister of the gate withdrew and transmitted the decree: "Attending officials, mount your horses.
translations.idiomatic: The vice minister of the gate withdrew and transmitted the decree: "Attending officials, mount your horses.

sentences.zh: 」通事舍人承傳：「敕侍臣上馬。

translations.literal: The communications attendant received and transmitted: "By imperial command, attending officials are to mount their horses.
translations.idiomatic: The communications attendant received and transmitted the order: "By imperial command, attending officials are to mount their horses.

sentences.zh: 」車駕還內，鼓吹振作，至應天門外，百官班迎起居，宮縣奏《采茨之曲》。

translations.literal: The imperial procession returned to the palace; drums and pipes sounded vigorously; outside the Gate of Responding to Heaven the officials formed ranks to welcome him and inquire after his well-being; the palace musicians performed the melody "Cai Ci."
translations.idiomatic: The imperial procession returned to the palace to the sound of drums and pipes. Outside the Gate of Responding to Heaven, officials formed ranks to welcome the emperor and inquire after his well-being, while the palace musicians performed the "Cai Ci" melody.

sentences.zh: 入應天門內，侍中奏：「請降輅乘輦。

translations.literal: Inside the Gate of Responding to Heaven, the chief minister memorialized: "I request that Your Majesty descend from the chariot and take the palanquin.
translations.idiomatic: Inside the Gate of Responding to Heaven, the chief minister reported: "I request that Your Majesty descend from the chariot and take the palanquin.

sentences.zh: 」皇帝降輅乘輦以入，傘扇侍衛警蹕如常儀。

translations.literal: The emperor descended from the chariot and entered on the palanquin; parasols, fans, guards, and way-clearing warnings followed as in the usual rite.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor descended from the chariot and entered on the palanquin, with parasols, fans, guards, and way-clearing warnings attending as usual.

sentences.zh: 皇帝入宮，至致齋殿，侍中奏：「解嚴。

translations.literal: The emperor entered the palace; reaching the fasting hall, the chief minister memorialized: "Strict silence is lifted.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor entered the palace, and when he reached the fasting hall the chief minister reported: "Strict silence is lifted.

sentences.zh: 」通事舍人承旨：「敕群臣各還次，將士各還本所。」

translations.literal: The communications attendant received the edict: "By imperial command, all officials are to return to their stations, and all officers and soldiers are to return to their posts."
translations.idiomatic: The communications attendant received the edict and announced: "By imperial command, all officials are to return to their stations, and all officers and soldiers are to return to their posts."

sentences.zh: 皇后恭謝儀

translations.literal: Rite of the Empress's Reverent Thanksgiving
translations.idiomatic: The Empress's Rite of Reverent Thanksgiving

sentences.zh: 皇后既受冊，前一日，齋戒於別殿。

translations.literal: Once the empress had received the investiture, on the day before she fasted and purified herself in a separate hall.
translations.idiomatic: After receiving investiture, the empress fasted and purified herself in a separate hall on the preceding day.

sentences.zh: 內命婦應從入廟者俱齋戒一日。

translations.literal: All inner titled ladies who were to accompany her into the temple likewise fasted and purified themselves for one day.
translations.idiomatic: All inner titled ladies who were to accompany her into the temple likewise observed a day of fasting and purification.

sentences.zh: 其日未明二刻，有司陳設儀仗于後車之左右，以次排列。

translations.literal: On that day, two quarters before dawn, the responsible officials set out the guard of honor to the left and right of the rear carriage, arranging them in order.
translations.idiomatic: On that day, two quarters before dawn, the responsible officials arranged the guard of honor on either side of the rear carriage in proper order.

sentences.zh: 外命婦先自太廟後門入，內命婦妃嬪已下俱詣殿庭，起居訖，宜徽使版奏：「中嚴。

translations.literal: The outer titled ladies entered first through the rear gate of the Grand Ancestral Temple; the inner titled ladies, consorts, and all those below them went together to the temple courtyard, and when the greeting of inquiry was finished the Xuanhui commissioner memorialized on the announcement board: "Strict silence within.
translations.idiomatic: The outer titled ladies entered first through the rear gate of the Grand Ancestral Temple. The inner titled ladies, consorts, and all those below them went to the temple courtyard, and when the greeting of inquiry was finished the Xuanhui commissioner announced on the board: "Strict silence within.

sentences.zh: 」少頃，又奏：「外辦。

translations.literal: After a short while he memorialized again: "The outer preparations are complete.
translations.idiomatic: After a short while he reported again: "The outer preparations are complete.

sentences.zh: 」首飾禕衣，禦肩輿，取便路至車所。

translations.literal: She put on her head ornaments and formal empress robe, took the shoulder palanquin, and went by the convenient route to the carriage station.
translations.idiomatic: She put on her head ornaments and formal empress robe, took the shoulder palanquin, and went by the direct route to the carriage station.

sentences.zh: 內侍奏：「請降輿升車。

translations.literal: A palace attendant memorialized: "I request that Your Majesty descend from the palanquin and ascend the carriage.
translations.idiomatic: A palace attendant reported: "I request that Your Majesty descend from the palanquin and ascend the carriage.

sentences.zh: 」既升車，奏：「請進發。

translations.literal: Once she had ascended the carriage, he memorialized: "I request that the procession depart.
translations.idiomatic: Once she had ascended the carriage, he reported: "I request that the procession depart.

sentences.zh: 」車出元德東偏門，內命婦妃嬪已下自殿門外上車，由左掖門出，從至太廟門外，儀仗止於門外，回車南向。

translations.literal: The carriage left through the east side gate of Yuande; the inner titled ladies, consorts, and all those below them mounted their carriages outside the palace gate, exited through the Left Side Gate, and followed to outside the Grand Ancestral Temple gate; the guard of honor halted outside the gate, and the carriage turned to face south.
translations.idiomatic: The carriage left through the east side gate of Yuande. The inner titled ladies, consorts, and all those below them mounted their carriages outside the palace gate, exited through the Left Side Gate, and followed to outside the Grand Ancestral Temple gate, where the guard of honor halted and the carriage turned to face south.

sentences.zh: 內侍奏：「請降車升輿。

translations.literal: A palace attendant memorialized: "I request that Your Majesty descend from the carriage and ascend the palanquin.
translations.idiomatic: A palace attendant reported: "I request that Your Majesty descend from the carriage and ascend the palanquin.

sentences.zh: 」後降車升輿，就東神門外幄次，下簾。

translations.literal: Thereafter she descended from the carriage and ascended the palanquin, went to the tent-side quarters outside the east spirit gate, and lowered the curtain.
translations.idiomatic: Thereafter she descended from the carriage, ascended the palanquin, went to the tent-side quarters outside the east spirit gate, and lowered the curtain.

sentences.zh: 內命婦妃嬪已下降車，入就陪列位。

translations.literal: The inner titled ladies, consorts, and all those below them descended from their carriages and entered to take their attendant ranks.
translations.idiomatic: The inner titled ladies, consorts, and all those below them descended from their carriages and took their attendant ranks.

sentences.zh: 內侍引外命婦詣幄次前，起居訖，並赴殿庭陪列位。

translations.literal: Palace attendants led the outer titled ladies to the front of the tent-side quarters; when the greeting of inquiry was finished, they all went to the temple courtyard to take their attendant ranks.
translations.idiomatic: Palace attendants led the outer titled ladies to the front of the tent-side quarters, and when the greeting of inquiry was finished they all went to the temple courtyard to take their attendant ranks.

sentences.zh: 少頃，宣徽使詣幄次，贊：「行朝謁之禮。

translations.literal: After a short while the Xuanhui commissioner went to the tent-side quarters and intoned: "Perform the rite of court audience.
translations.idiomatic: After a short while the Xuanhui commissioner went to the tent-side quarters and announced: "Perform the rite of court audience.

sentences.zh: 」簾卷，宜徽使前導，詣殿庭階下西向褥位立。

translations.literal: The curtain was raised; the Xuanhui commissioner led the way, and she went to the mat seat below the temple-court steps and stood facing west.
translations.idiomatic: The curtain was raised. The Xuanhui commissioner led the way to the mat seat below the temple-court steps, where she stood facing west.

sentences.zh: 宣徽使贊：「再拜。

translations.literal: The Xuanhui commissioner intoned: "Bow twice.
translations.idiomatic: The Xuanhui commissioner announced: "Bow twice.

sentences.zh: 」內外命婦皆再拜。

translations.literal: The inner and outer titled ladies all bowed twice.
translations.idiomatic: The inner and outer titled ladies all bowed twice.

sentences.zh: 宣徽使前導，升東階，詣始祖皇帝神位香案前褥位，宣徽使奏：「請三上香。

translations.literal: The Xuanhui commissioner led the way up the east steps to the mat seat before the incense table at the founding ancestor emperor's spirit seat; the Xuanhui commissioner memorialized: "I request three offerings of incense.
translations.idiomatic: The Xuanhui commissioner led the way up the east steps to the mat seat before the incense table at the founding ancestor emperor's spirit seat and reported: "I request three offerings of incense.

sentences.zh: 」又奏：「再拜。

translations.literal: He memorialized again: "Bow twice.
translations.idiomatic: He reported again: "Bow twice.

sentences.zh: 」拜訖。

translations.literal: When the bows were finished,
translations.idiomatic: When the bows were finished,

sentences.zh: 宣徽使前導，次詣獻祖已下十室，並如上儀。

translations.literal: the Xuanhui commissioner led the way next to the ten chambers from the Offering Ancestor downward, all according to the rite above.
translations.idiomatic: the Xuanhui commissioner led the way next to the ten chambers from the Offering Ancestor downward, following the same rite throughout.

sentences.zh: 宣徽使奏：「禮畢。

translations.literal: The Xuanhui commissioner memorialized: "The rite is complete.
